author: B

components.title: Filter and deduplicate orders
components.what: Remove cancelled and returned orders; remove exact duplicate rows (same order_id and all other fields) so each order counts once.

components.title: Compute revenue per order
components.what: For each remaining order, calculate revenue = units × unit_price.

components.title: Total revenue by customer
components.what: Sum revenue by customer_id and identify the customer with the highest total.

components.title: Report customer name
components.what: Map the highest-revenue customer_id to the customer name from the Customers table.
